# Third-party citation style

The accompanying `plos_innovation.csl` derives from the PLOS citation style retained in the repository. Its original author/contributor metadata and CC BY-SA 3.0 notice remain in the file. This revision preserves explicit arXiv identifiers and preprint details. The style is excluded from the manuscript author's CC BY 4.0 / MIT grant and retains its own CC BY-SA 3.0 terms: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/ .

The source and field-level comparison are documented in `Verification/reference_metadata_comparison.json`. No fonts or installed third-party packages are distributed here.
